title: Highly pathogenic avian influenza virus H5N1 infection in stranded porpoises and dolphins in Chile
abstract: Between 2022 and 2023, a significant increase in mortality among marine birds and pinnipeds along the Pacific coasts of Peru and Chile was linked to the highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV H5N1). In response, the Chilean Fisheries and Aquaculture Service (SERNAPESCA) initiated a survey to document cetacean strandings and assess the presence of HPAIV H5N1 via molecular analysis of swab samples. In 2023, 205 cetacean stranding events involving 281 individuals were recorded. Of the 27 sampled animals, four, comprising two Burmeister’s porpoises ( Phocoena spinipinnis ) and two Chilean dolphins ( Cephalorhynchus eutropia ) from different locations, tested positive for HPAIV H5N1 in spiracle, rectal and genital swabs. Additionally, a necropsy performed on a long-beaked common dolphin ( Delphinus delphis ), which had tested negative on swabs, revealed the presence of HPAIV H5N1 through PCR analysis of lung and brain tissues. Histopathological examination showed mild, multifocal lymphoplasmacytic-histiocytic and suppurative leptomeningitis, consistent with lesions associated with HPAIV H5N1 infection, although immunohistochemistry was negative. While the virus’s pathogenic role in cetaceans remains inconclusive due to the limited number of necropsies performed, the detection of HPAIV H5N1 in five cetaceans (two porpoises and three dolphins), Four through external swabs —and one dolphin through internal organs—alongside with elevated mortality in birds and pinnipeds, suggests a potential association between cetacean strandings and HPAIV H5N1 outbreaks. This epidemiological finding warrants further investigation.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the potential link between HPAIV H5N1 outbreaks and increased cetacean strandings in Chile. Between 2022 and 2023, a notable rise in marine bird and pinniped mortality was observed, prompting a survey by SERNAPESCA to assess HPAIV H5N1 presence in cetaceans. In 2023, 205 stranding events involving 281 individuals were recorded, with four cetaceans testing positive for HPAIV H5N1 through swabs and one through necropsy. Histopathological findings were consistent with HPAIV H5N1 infection, though immunohistochemistry was negative. The review highlights the inconclusive role of the virus in cetacean mortality and calls for further research to clarify its impact and transmission mechanisms.

While the virus’s pathogenic role in cetaceans remains inconclusive due to the limited number of necropsies performed, the detection of HPAIV H5N1 in five cetaceans (two porpoises and three dolphins), Four through external swabs —and one dolphin through internal organs—alongside with elevated mortality in birds and pinnipeds, suggests a potential association between cetacean strandings and HPAIV H5N1 outbreaks. This epidemiological finding warrants further investigation.

title: Co-circulation of H5N1 and H5N6 High Pathogenicity Avian Influenza Viruses in Migratory Birds at a Coastal Wintering Site in China
abstract: Since 2020, H5Nx high Pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (HPAIVs) belonging to hemagglutinin (HA) clade 2.3.4.4b have undergone widespread dispersal in wild birds, posing substantial threats to global poultry populations and mammals worldwide. In this study, we report the co-circulation of clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 and H5N6 HPAIVs associated with mortality events in Anseriformes and Charadriiformes at a coastal wintering site in Fujian Province, China. H5N1 and H5N6 viruses were identified in 4 species of waterfowl (Bean Goose, Eastern Spot-billed Duck, Eurasian Wigeon, and Eurasian Curlew). Phylogenetic analysis indicated that these H5N1 and H5N6 isolates were clade 2.3.4.4b strains circulating within Eurasia and lacked known mammalian adaptation markers in key proteins. The infected birds exhibited severe systemic multi-organ pathology, with the most pronounced damage observed in the lungs. H5N6 and H5N1 viruses caused lethal injury in BALB/c mice, with H5N1 leading to systemic infection. Environmental sampling also revealed the presence of H5N1 HPAIVs alongside low-pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (LPAIVs) such as H3N1 and H6N1. Our findings highlight the complex and dynamic transmission patterns of H5 HPAIV in wild bird populations and the substantial threat they pose to mammals, underscoring the critical importance of sustained surveillance for high pathogenicity avian influenza in wild birds.

title_zh: 中国沿海越冬地迁徙鸟类中H5N1和H5N6高致病性禽流感病毒的共循环
source_body_en: Since 2020, H5Nx high Pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (HPAIVs) belonging to hemagglutinin (HA) clade 2.3.4.4b have undergone widespread dispersal in wild birds, posing substantial threats to global poultry populations and mammals worldwide. In this study, we report the co-circulation of clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 and H5N6 HPAIVs associated with mortality events in Anseriformes and Charadriiformes at a coastal wintering site in Fujian Province, China. H5N1 and H5N6 viruses were identified in 4 species of waterfowl (Bean Goose, Eastern Spot-billed Duck, Eurasian Wigeon, and Eurasian Curlew). Phylogenetic analysis indicated that these H5N1 and H5N6 isolates were clade 2.3.4.4b strains circulating within Eurasia and lacked known mammalian adaptation markers in key proteins. The infected birds exhibited severe systemic multi-organ pathology, with the most pronounced damage observed in the lungs. H5N6 and H5N1 viruses caused lethal injury in BALB/c mice, with H5N1 leading to systemic infection. Environmental sampling also revealed the presence of H5N1 HPAIVs alongside low-pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (LPAIVs) such as H3N1 and H6N1. Our findings highlight the complex and dynamic transmission patterns of H5 HPAIV in wild bird populations and the substantial threat they pose to mammals, underscoring the critical importance of sustained surveillance for high pathogenicity avian influenza in wild birds.
abstract_zh: 自2020年以来,属于血凝素(HA)亚型2.3.4.4b的H5Nx高致病性禽流感病毒(HPAIVs)在野生鸟类中广泛传播,对全球家禽种群和世界各地的哺乳动物构成重大威胁。本研究报告了在中国福建省沿海越冬地,雁形目和鸻形目鸟类中与死亡率事件相关的HA亚型2.3.4.4b H5N1和H5N6 HPAIVs的共循环现象。H5N1和H5N6病毒在4种水禽(豆雁、东斑鸭、欧斑鸭和欧文鸟)中被鉴定出来。系统发育分析表明,这些H5N1和H5N6分离株是流行于欧亚大陆的HA亚型2.3.4.4b毒株,并且在关键蛋白中缺乏已知的哺乳动物适应性标记。感染的鸟类表现出严重的全身多器官病理变化,其中肺部损伤最为显著。H5N6和H5N1病毒在BALB/c小鼠中导致致命性损伤,其中H5N1病毒引发全身感染。环境采样还显示H5N1 HPAIVs与低致病性禽流感病毒(LPAIVs)如H3N1和H6N1共存。我们的研究结果突显了H5 HPAIV在野生鸟类种群中复杂的动态传播模式,并强调了其对哺乳动物构成的重大威胁,凸显了对高致病性禽流感病毒在野生鸟类中进行持续监测的重要性。

title: Mammalian H5N1 cases predict online discourse volume and emotion during the 2024–2025 H5N1 outbreak
abstract: Abstract The surge of highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) infection in animals across the United States since 2024 has renewed pandemic concern, making public perception a critical determinant of effective risk communication. We analyzed 42,957 Reddit comments (January 2024–December 2025) to characterize the patterns in online discourse during the outbreak. Topic modeling identified themes of public health, pandemic comparisons, and food safety. Sentiment analysis identified fear as the dominant emotional response, while anger was the most event-reactive, correlating with reported cases in cats, poultry, and wild mammals. Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Regressors (ARIMAX) models with blocked cross-validation identified reported cases in domestic cats and dairy cattle as predictors of weekly Reddit engagement, reducing forecasting error by 31% over baseline. Mammalian cases thus were associated with early-warning signals for public reaction during the 2024–2025 outbreak, offering a one-week window for proactive risk communication.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the relationship between mammalian H5N1 cases and public perception during the 2024–2025 outbreak. They found that reported cases in cats, poultry, and wild mammals correlated with anger, while ARIMAX models with blocked cross-validation showed that domestic cat and dairy cattle cases predicted weekly Reddit engagement, reducing forecasting error by 31%. However, the reliance on online data introduces potential biases, limiting the strength of the evidence. The findings have implications for monitoring public sentiment and improving risk communication strategies during H5N1 outbreaks.

title: Genetic modification of primary airway epithelial cell cultures defines MX1 as a barrier for zoonotic influenza A viruses in the human respiratory epithelium
abstract: The antiviral innate immune response is a major species barrier that emerging viruses must overcome to infect and transmit efficiently in new hosts. In humans, the interferon-stimulated MX1 gene encodes the antiviral MX1 protein, which restricts zoonotic influenza A viruses (IAVs). Resistance to MX1 is considered a key feature of human-adapted IAVs and a potential determinant of zoonotic and pandemic risk. However, MX1-mediated restriction and viral escape have mostly been investigated in cell lines and animal models, which incompletely recapitulate virus-host interactions in the human airway epithelium, representing the primary site of IAV replication. Although primary human airway epithelial cell (hAEC) cultures, such as airway organoids and air-liquid interface (ALI) cultures, provide a physiologically relevant model, their use in studying MX1 restriction has been limited by challenges in achieving efficient and reliable genetic modification. Here, we used engineered virus-like particles (eVLPs) to deliver Cas9-sgRNA ribonucleoprotein complexes into primary hAECs and disrupt MX1 expression. This approach generated MX1-knockout airway organoids and organoid-derived hAEC ALI cultures with >90% genomic-level editing efficiency and near-complete loss of MX1 protein, while preserving epithelial differentiation at the air-liquid interface. MX1 knockout in hAEC ALI cultures had only a minor effect on the replication kinetics of the human-adapted H1N1pdm09 strain. By contrast, MX1 knockout markedly impaired interferon lambda-mediated restriction of the zoonotic bovine H5N1/Texas and avian H7N9/Anhui strains, resulting in viral titers up to 3-4 logs TCID50 higher than in MX1-competent cultures. These findings provide direct evidence that MX1 restricts zoonotic IAVs in primary human airway epithelium. Our study establishes a biologically relevant platform for assessing the sensitivity of emerging IAVs to a key antiviral host factor and thereby informs evaluations into their zoonotic and pandemic risk.

title_zh: 原代气道上皮细胞培养的基因改造定义了MX1作为人呼吸道上皮中人兽共患病流感A病毒的屏障
source_body_en: The antiviral innate immune response is a major species barrier that emerging viruses must overcome to infect and transmit efficiently in new hosts. In humans, the interferon-stimulated MX1 gene encodes the antiviral MX1 protein, which restricts zoonotic influenza A viruses (IAVs). Resistance to MX1 is considered a key feature of human-adapted IAVs and a potential determinant of zoonotic and pandemic risk. However, MX1-mediated restriction and viral escape have mostly been investigated in cell lines and animal models, which incompletely recapitulate virus-host interactions in the human airway epithelium, representing the primary site of IAV replication. Although primary human airway epithelial cell (hAEC) cultures, such as airway organoids and air-liquid interface (ALI) cultures, provide a physiologically relevant model, their use in studying MX1 restriction has been limited by challenges in achieving efficient and reliable genetic modification. Here, we used engineered virus-like particles (eVLPs) to deliver Cas9-sgRNA ribonucleoprotein complexes into primary hAECs and disrupt MX1 expression. This approach generated MX1-knockout airway organoids and organoid-derived hAEC ALI cultures with >90% genomic-level editing efficiency and near-complete loss of MX1 protein, while preserving epithelial differentiation at the air-liquid interface. MX1 knockout in hAEC ALI cultures had only a minor effect on the replication kinetics of the human-adapted H1N1pdm09 strain. By contrast, MX1 knockout markedly impaired interferon lambda-mediated restriction of the zoonotic bovine H5N1/Texas and avian H7N9/Anhui strains, resulting in viral titers up to 3-4 logs TCID50 higher than in MX1-competent cultures. These findings provide direct evidence that MX1 restricts zoonotic IAVs in primary human airway epithelium. Our study establishes a biologically relevant platform for assessing the sensitivity of emerging IAVs to a key antiviral host factor and thereby informs evaluations into their zoonotic and pandemic risk.
abstract_zh: 先天性抗病毒屏障抗病毒药物是新兴病毒必须克服的主要物种屏障,以在新的宿主宿主中有效感染和传播。在人类中,干扰素刺激的MX1基因编码抗病毒屏障MX1蛋白,该蛋白限制了人兽共患病流感A病毒(IAVs)。对MX1的抗性被认为是适应人类的IAVs的关键特征,也是人兽共患病和大流行风险的潜在决定因素。然而,MX1介导的限制和病毒逃逸机制大多是在细胞系和动物模型中研究的,这些模型无法完全再现病毒与人类气道上皮细胞的相互作用,而人类气道上皮细胞是IAVs复制的主要部位。尽管原代人类气道上皮细胞(hAEC)培养,如气道类器官和气液界面(ALI)培养,提供了生理相关的模型,但其在研究MX1限制作用方面受到实现高效且可靠基因改造的挑战的限制。在这里,我们使用工程化的病毒样颗粒(eVLPs)将Cas9-sgRNA核糖核蛋白复合物递送至原代hAEC中,以破坏MX1的表达。这种方法产生了具有>90%基因组水平编辑效率且几乎完全丧失MX1蛋白的MX1敲除气道类器官和类器官衍生的hAEC ALI培养。在hAEC ALI培养中敲除MX1对适应人类的H1N1pdm09菌株的复制动力学仅有轻微影响,但对人兽共患病牛源H5N1/Texas和禽源H7N9/Anhui菌株的干扰素λ介导的限制作用则显著削弱,导致病毒滴度比MX1功能正常的培养高3-4个对数TCID50。这些发现直接证明了MX1在原代人类气道上皮中限制人兽共患病IAVs的作用。本研究建立了一个生物相关平台,用于评估新兴IAVs对关键宿主因素宿主的敏感性,从而为评估其人兽共患病和大流行风险提供了信息。

title: Variable transmission efficiency of mammalian origin HPAI D1.1 H5N1 strains in ferrets
abstract: AbstractHighly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 2.3.4.4b genotype D1.1 lineage continues to predominate in the United States wild bird population and has spilled over into dairy cattle three independent times. To assess the transmission risk of this sublineage, we performed direct-contact transmission experiments for three distinct D1.1 strains in ferrets. Two of these strains were isolated from humans and one from a lethal cat infection. We found that only one human isolate (A/NV/10/2025) was able to transmit efficiently between ferrets. Compared to the other strains, this isolate harbored the mammalian adaptive PB2 D701N mutation, suggesting this mutation may be a candidate contributing to enhanced transmission efficiency of D1.1 as opposed to the PB2 E627 K substitution present in the lethal cat isolate. Based on these data we conclude that the transmission fitness of D1.1 strains is modest but special attention should be paid to emergence of adaptation at the PB2 701 position.

analysis_zh.main_results: 仅有一种人类分离株A/NV/10/2025被发现能够在雪貂之间高效传播。其他毒株,包括致命猫分离株,均未表现出高效的传播能力。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,哺乳动物适应性PB2 D701N突变可能增强D1.1系H5N1毒株的传播效率,这与猫分离株中所含的PB2 E627K替代突变不同。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果强调了监测高致病性禽流感D1.1系毒株中特定突变的重要性,因为这些突变可能增加其传播效率,这对人兽共患病风险评估具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于雪貂模型,未考虑其他潜在的传播途径或环境因素。证据强度中等,因为其基于受控实验条件,而非真实世界数据。

title: Highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza infection and exposure in waterfowl and waterbirds of the Sacramento National Wildlife Refuge Complex, 2022-2025
abstract: The introduction of clade 2.3.4.4b highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 into North America in 2021 marked a significant shift in disease dynamics for wild waterfowl populations. To assess infection and seroprevalence trends following this incursion, we leveraged ongoing capture efforts at the Sacramento National Wildlife Refuge Complex between October 2022 and July 2025 to conduct sampling for HPAI H5N1 prevalence and seroprevalence. Our efforts resulted in the analysis of 384 swab and 204 sera samples from assorted waterfowl and waterbird species. HPAI H5N1 infection was confirmed in only three individuals (two Snow Geese and one Greater White-fronted Goose), all asymptomatic at capture. Antibodies to influenza A viruses (IAVs) were detected in all duck and goose species with the majority of positive samples also testing positive for antibodies to both H5 and N1, demonstrating a relatively high population level of previous exposure and likely immunity that aligns with previous findings in these species. This study also reports the first known observation of H5 antibodies in American Coot, though both overall IAV seroprevalence and H5 specific antibodies were notably lower than in sympatric waterfowl. This disparity suggests that American Coot may have lower susceptibility to infection or exhibit behavior that limits exposure compared to sympatric waterfowl. Together these results underscore the value of serologic surveillance as a supportive surveillance strategy to better inform potential management strategies related to HPAI H5N1 risk in wild birds.
journal: Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology

abstract_zh: 2021年高致病性禽流感(HPAI)H5N1病毒亚型2.3.4.4b 高致病性禽流感传入北美,标志着野生水禽种群疾病动态的重大转变。为评估此次入侵后感染和血清流行率的趋势,我们利用2022年10月至2025年7月期间在萨克拉门托国家野生动物保护区复合体进行的持续捕捉活动,采集样本以检测HPAI H5N1 患病率和血清流行率。我们的工作共分析了384份拭子样本和204份血清样本,来自多种水禽和水鸟物种。仅在三只个体(两只雪雁和一只大白额雁)中确认了HPAI H5N1感染,且这些个体在捕捉时均无症状。所有鸭类和鹅类物种均检测到流感A病毒(IAVs)抗体,其中大多数阳性样本同时检测到H5和N1抗体,表明这些物种中存在相对较高的既往暴露水平和可能的免疫力,这与之前在这些物种中的发现一致。本研究还首次报告了在美国黑水鸡中检测到H5抗体,尽管其总体IAVs 血清流行率和H5特异性抗体水平明显低于同域水禽。这种差异表明,美国黑水鸡可能对感染的易感性较低,或表现出限制暴露的行为。这些结果共同强调了血清学监测作为支持性监测策略的价值,有助于更好地制定与HPAI H5N1风险相关的管理策略(A1,A2).

title: Rapid UAV-based detection of crane (Grus grus) mortality hotspots during an H5N1 avian influenza outbreak using deep learning
abstract: Rapid detection of wildlife mortality during infectious disease outbreaks is essential for ecological risk mitigation, zoonotic-risk management, and timely intervention, yet field surveys are often slow, labor-intensive, and spatially limited. This study evaluates unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery combined with deep learning as an operational surveillance tool for mapping live and deceased Common Cranes ( Grus grus ) during a highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1) outbreak in the Hula Valley, Israel. High-resolution RGB imagery was collected over aquatic roosting and terrestrial feeding habitats and annotated to distinguish living and dead individuals. A YOLOv8-based detection framework was tested using habitat-specific training, combined multi-habitat training, and transfer learning from a large avian dataset, together with selective data augmentation, sliding-window inference, and Weighted Boxes Fusion. Living cranes were detected reliably across habitats, with AP@50 reaching 0.89 in mosaicked feeding-area imagery and 0.98 in raw feeding-area imagery. Dead cranes were detected accurately in water bodies (AP@50 ≈ 0.90), but detection in terrestrial feeding areas remained more limited (AP@50 ≈ 0.64–0.70), based on aerial annotations without in situ confirmation. Oversampling, undersampling, and focal loss provided limited improvement, suggesting that class imbalance alone does not fully explain the lower terrestrial detection performance, and that carcass scarcity, limited visual diversity, and ambiguity against heterogeneous ground backgrounds may also contribute. Joint multi-habitat training and transfer learning improved generalization for the rare dead-crane class on land. These findings demonstrate the value of UAV-based deep learning for rapid mortality assessment and hotspot identification during wildlife disease outbreaks.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the use of UAV-based deep learning for rapid detection of Common Crane mortality during an H5N1 avian influenza outbreak in the Hula Valley, Israel. The research highlights the importance of efficient surveillance methods in managing ecological and zoonotic risks. High-resolution RGB imagery was collected and annotated to distinguish living and dead individuals, with a YOLOv8-based framework tested using habitat-specific training, transfer learning, and data augmentation. The results showed reliable detection of living cranes across habitats, with high AP@50 scores, while detection of dead cranes in terrestrial areas was less accurate. The study suggests that UAV-based deep learning can be a valuable tool for identifying mortality hotspots during wildlife disease outbreaks, though limitations in terrestrial detection performance were noted due to factors like carcass scarcity and visual ambiguity. The findings have implications for improving surveillance strategies in avian influenza outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 在传染病暴发期间对野生动物热点区域进行快速检测对于生态风险缓解、人兽共患病风险管理和及时干预至关重要,但实地调查往往耗时、劳动密集且空间受限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了结合深度学习的无人机(UAV)图像作为一种操作性工具,用于在以色列胡拉谷地H5N1禽流感暴发期间绘制存活和死亡的普通白鹤(Grus grus)的分布情况。
elements_zh.methods: 高分辨率RGB图像在水生栖息地和陆地觅食栖息地采集,并进行标注以区分存活和死亡个体。基于YOLOv8的检测框架通过特定栖息地训练、多栖息地联合训练和从大型鸟类数据集进行的迁移学习进行了测试,同时结合选择性数据增强、滑动窗口推理和加权框融合技术。
elements_zh.main_results: 存活的白鹤在不同栖息地中被可靠检测,其在拼接觅食区图像中的AP@50达到0.89,在原始觅食区图像中的AP@50达到0.98。死亡的白鹤在水体中被准确检测(AP@50≈0.90),但在陆地觅食区的检测仍较为有限(AP@50≈0.64–0.70),这是基于空中标注而没有现场确认的结果。

title_zh: 基于无人机的快速检测在H5N1禽流感暴发期间对白鹤(Grus grus)热点区域的识别中使用深度学习
source_body_en: Rapid detection of wildlife mortality during infectious disease outbreaks is essential for ecological risk mitigation, zoonotic-risk management, and timely intervention, yet field surveys are often slow, labor-intensive, and spatially limited. This study evaluates unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery combined with deep learning as an operational surveillance tool for mapping live and deceased Common Cranes ( Grus grus ) during a highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1) outbreak in the Hula Valley, Israel. High-resolution RGB imagery was collected over aquatic roosting and terrestrial feeding habitats and annotated to distinguish living and dead individuals. A YOLOv8-based detection framework was tested using habitat-specific training, combined multi-habitat training, and transfer learning from a large avian dataset, together with selective data augmentation, sliding-window inference, and Weighted Boxes Fusion. Living cranes were detected reliably across habitats, with AP@50 reaching 0.89 in mosaicked feeding-area imagery and 0.98 in raw feeding-area imagery. Dead cranes were detected accurately in water bodies (AP@50 ≈ 0.90), but detection in terrestrial feeding areas remained more limited (AP@50 ≈ 0.64–0.70), based on aerial annotations without in situ confirmation. Oversampling, undersampling, and focal loss provided limited improvement, suggesting that class imbalance alone does not fully explain the lower terrestrial detection performance, and that carcass scarcity, limited visual diversity, and ambiguity against heterogeneous ground backgrounds may also contribute. Joint multi-habitat training and transfer learning improved generalization for the rare dead-crane class on land. These findings demonstrate the value of UAV-based deep learning for rapid mortality assessment and hotspot identification during wildlife disease outbreaks.
abstract_zh: 在传染病暴发期间对野生动物热点区域进行快速检测对于生态风险缓解、人兽共患病风险管理和及时干预至关重要,但实地调查往往耗时、劳动密集且空间受限。本研究评估了结合深度学习的无人机(UAV)图像作为一种操作性工具,用于在以色列胡拉谷地H5N1禽流感暴发期间绘制存活和死亡的普通白鹤(Grus grus)的分布情况。高分辨率RGB图像在水生栖息地和陆地觅食栖息地采集,并进行标注以区分存活和死亡个体。基于YOLOv8的检测框架通过特定栖息地训练、多栖息地联合训练和从大型鸟类数据集进行的迁移学习进行了测试,同时结合选择性数据增强、滑动窗口推理和加权框融合技术。存活的白鹤在不同栖息地中被可靠检测,其在拼接觅食区图像中的AP@50达到0.89,在原始觅食区图像中的AP@50达到0.98。死亡的白鹤在水体中被准确检测(AP@50≈0.90),但在陆地觅食区的检测仍较为有限(AP@50≈0.64–0.70),这是基于空中标注而没有现场确认的结果。过采样、欠采样和焦点损失提供了有限的改进,表明仅类别不平衡并不能完全解释陆地检测性能较低的原因,而尸体稀缺、视觉多样性有限以及与异质地面背景的模糊性也可能有所贡献。多栖息地联合训练和迁移学习提高了对陆地罕见死亡白鹤类别的泛化能力。这些发现展示了基于无人机的深度学习在野生动物疾病暴发期间进行快速热点识别和评估的价值。

title: Rethinking avian influenza control: a systems-oriented One Health perspective for family poultry
abstract: Early detection and control of high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI, LPAI) in family poultry flocks remain challenging in settings where mortality from enzootic diseases such as Newcastle disease (ND) and infectious bursal disease (IBD) is persistently high. High background mortality obscures recognition of unusual disease events and delays reporting. In addition to epidemiological constraints, rebuilding trust among family poultry producers, particularly those affected by uncompensated culling during previous HPAI outbreaks, is essential for effective control. Locally grounded, participatory approaches that recognize the lived experience of both women and men poultry keepers are required to strengthen surveillance, reporting, and response. This policy-oriented rapid review synthesized 110 peer-reviewed publications and 27 policy and guidance documents to examine the structural, epidemiological and socio-economic factors influencing HPAI and LPAI prevention and control in family poultry systems. Effective HPAI and LPAI control should be embedded within a broader, systems-oriented strategy that improves overall poultry productivity and explicitly values smallholder knowledge and participation. A multi-hazard risk management approach grounded in One Health is required, i.e., one that addresses equity, food and nutrition security, livelihoods, climate resilience, and global health. Building on a nine-factor assessment of the factors shaping avian influenza control feasibility, we group practical entry points into three complementary themes: (1) structural constraints within family poultry production systems, including the use of locally adapted poultry genotypes, safe, improved access to safe markets and sustainable feed systems, and effective control of enzootic vaccine-preventable diseases; (2) governance, institutional and social barriers, including culturally appropriate outbreak preparedness and response protocols; (3) gender and socio-economic equity, encompassing participatory approaches grounded in inclusivity, transparency, and accountability. Functional cross-sectoral collaboration between public health, animal health, and environmental sectors, along with local government, is essential if One Health approaches are to deliver tangible, cost-effective reductions in zoonotic risk and effective response while supporting sustainable household food and nutrition security.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the challenges of controlling avian influenza A viruses, particularly high- and low-pathogenicity strains, in family poultry systems. It emphasizes the need for a systems-oriented approach that integrates structural, epidemiological, and socio-economic factors. The review highlights the importance of participatory methods, trust-building among poultry keepers, and cross-sectoral collaboration to enhance surveillance and response. Despite the synthesis of 110 peer-reviewed publications and 27 policy documents, gaps remain in addressing high background mortality and ensuring equitable participation in control efforts.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于禽流感 A型病毒,具体探讨在家庭家禽系统中早期检测和控制高致病性和低致病性禽流感(HPAI,LPAI)所面临的挑战。它分析了影响预防和控制的结构性、流行病学和社会经济因素,并强调提高家禽生产力和纳入小农户知识与参与的重要性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是一项政策导向的快速综述,综合了110篇同行评审的文献和27份政策与指导文件。它分析了影响家庭家禽系统中HPAI和LPAI预防与控制的结构性、流行病学和社会经济因素,重点在于家禽饲养者的实际经验以及对参与式方法的需求。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 有共识认为,有效的HPAI和LPAI控制必须嵌入更广泛的系统导向策略中,以提高整体家禽生产力并重视小农户的知识和参与。此外,基于One Health的多危害风险管理方法是必要的,以应对公平性、粮食和营养安全、生计、气候韧性以及全球健康问题。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 来自地方性疾病如新城疫和传染性法氏囊病的高背景死亡率会掩盖异常疾病事件的识别并延迟报告。此外,还需要重建家庭家禽生产者之间的信任,特别是那些在之前HPAI 暴发中遭受无补偿扑杀影响的生产者。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要基于本地实际情况、参与式的方法,以承认男女家禽饲养者的实际经验,从而加强监测、报告和响应。公共卫生、动物健康和环境部门之间,以及与地方政府之间的功能性跨部门合作,对于有效的One Health方法至关重要。

source_body_en: Early detection and control of high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI, LPAI) in family poultry flocks remain challenging in settings where mortality from enzootic diseases such as Newcastle disease (ND) and infectious bursal disease (IBD) is persistently high. High background mortality obscures recognition of unusual disease events and delays reporting. In addition to epidemiological constraints, rebuilding trust among family poultry producers, particularly those affected by uncompensated culling during previous HPAI outbreaks, is essential for effective control. Locally grounded, participatory approaches that recognize the lived experience of both women and men poultry keepers are required to strengthen surveillance, reporting, and response. This policy-oriented rapid review synthesized 110 peer-reviewed publications and 27 policy and guidance documents to examine the structural, epidemiological and socio-economic factors influencing HPAI and LPAI prevention and control in family poultry systems. Effective HPAI and LPAI control should be embedded within a broader, systems-oriented strategy that improves overall poultry productivity and explicitly values smallholder knowledge and participation. A multi-hazard risk management approach grounded in One Health is required, i.e., one that addresses equity, food and nutrition security, livelihoods, climate resilience, and global health. Building on a nine-factor assessment of the factors shaping avian influenza control feasibility, we group practical entry points into three complementary themes: (1) structural constraints within family poultry production systems, including the use of locally adapted poultry genotypes, safe, improved access to safe markets and sustainable feed systems, and effective control of enzootic vaccine-preventable diseases; (2) governance, institutional and social barriers, including culturally appropriate outbreak preparedness and response protocols; (3) gender and socio-economic equity, encompassing participatory approaches grounded in inclusivity, transparency, and accountability. Functional cross-sectoral collaboration between public health, animal health, and environmental sectors, along with local government, is essential if One Health approaches are to deliver tangible, cost-effective reductions in zoonotic risk and effective response while supporting sustainable household food and nutrition security.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于禽流感 A型病毒,具体探讨在家庭家禽系统中早期检测和控制高致病性和低致病性禽流感(HPAI,LPAI)所面临的挑战。它分析了影响预防和控制的结构性、流行病学和社会经济因素,并强调提高家禽生产力和纳入小农户知识与参与的重要性。

title: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza H5N1 in Missouri: Current Situation and Pandemic Potential.
abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1, which has caused severe disease in poultry since 1996, has become panzootic in wild birds and recently has spread to dairy cattle and other mammalian species in the United States. Although few human cases have been reported, devastating HPAI H5N1 poultry outbreaks and massive dieoffs in wild birds and in some mammals raise concern about pandemic potential. Surveillance, early detection, public health interventions, farm biosecurity measures, and next-generation vaccines may reduce the risk of a future HPAI H5N1 pandemic.

Surveillance, early detection, public health interventions, farm biosecurity measures, and next-generation vaccines may reduce the risk of a future HPAI H5N1 pandemic.
title_original: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza H5N1 in Missouri: Current Situation and Pandemic Potential.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1, which has caused severe disease in poultry since 1996, has become panzootic in wild birds and recently has spread to dairy cattle and other mammalian species in the United States.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focuses on the current situation of HPAI H5N1 in Missouri, examining its spread to poultry, wild birds, and some mammals.
analysis.methods: The study relies on surveillance data, outbreak reports, and observations of HPAI H5N1 spread in Missouri, including its presence in poultry, wild birds, and some mammals.
analysis.main_results: Although few human cases have been reported, devastating HPAI H5N1 poultry outbreaks and massive dieoffs in wild birds and in some mammals raise concern about pandemic potential.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as indicating a growing concern for pandemic potential due to the spread of HPAI H5N1 to various animal species, highlighting the need for increased vigilance.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the importance of surveillance, early detection, and public health interventions to mitigate the risk of a future HPAI H5N1 pandemic.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on observational data and does not include detailed statistical analysis, which may limit the strength of the evidence regarding pandemic potential.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the current situation of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 in Missouri, highlighting its spread to poultry, wild birds, and some mammals. The research underscores the growing concern about pandemic potential due to the severity of outbreaks and die-offs. The authors emphasize the importance of surveillance, early detection, and public health interventions to reduce the risk of a future HPAI H5N1 pandemic. However, the study is based on observational data without detailed statistical analysis, which may limit the strength of the evidence. The findings suggest that farm biosecurity measures and next-generation vaccines could play a critical role in preventing the spread of HPAI H5N1 to humans.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于密苏里州高致病性禽流感H5N1的当前状况,考察其在禽类、野生鸟类和某些哺乳动物中的传播情况。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为由于高致病性禽流感H5N1在多种动物物种中的传播,对大流行潜力的担忧正在增加,强调了需要提高警惕性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了加强监测、早期发现和公共卫生干预措施在降低未来高致病性禽流感H5N1大流行风险中的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于观察性数据,未包含详细的统计分析,这可能限制了关于大流行潜力的证据强度。

title: Dairy producers' perceptions of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 and their influence on implementation of biosecurity changes
abstract: The emergence of highly pathogenic avian influenza(HPAI) H5N1 in dairy cattle has presented a major challengefor dairy producers in the United States, who havehad to make biosecurity decisions with limited informationwhile balancing evolving guidance, existing beliefs,and farm management constraints. This study aimed(1) to describe dairy producers’ perceptions and understandingof HPAI; (2) to characterize experiences andperceived influence among producers affected by HPAI;(3) to identify farm characteristics associated with implementationof biosecurity changes in response to HPAIrisk; and (4) to assess whether perceived biosecurityeffectiveness was associated with implementation of biosecuritychanges and whether concern about HPAI andperceived farm-level risk helped explain this relationship.A questionnaire mailed to Michigan dairy facilitiesyielded a 15.6% response rate (n = 120/766). Descriptivestatistics, modified Poisson regression, logistic regression,and parallel mediation analysis using parametricg-computation were used to evaluate survey responsesand associations with implementation of biosecuritychanges. Overall, 18 respondents (15%) reported confirmedor suspected HPAI on their farms. Most respondentsreported being moderately to very familiar withHPAI (76%) and receiving sufficient guidance about thedisease (83%). The most frequently selected informationsources were veterinary professionals (72%), governmenthealth agencies (52%), and industry associations (48%).Producers most frequently identified wildlife (74%) as alikely route of HPAI introduction, followed by airbornetransmission (34%), cattle movement (23%), and sharingworkers with other operations (12%). Among affectedfarms, the reported clinical phase lasted a median of 21d, whereas reduced productivity lasted a median of 40d. Median self-estimated economic loss was $152 perlactating cow. Among farms without reported confirmedor suspected HPAI, farms with ≥15 employees were morelikely to report implementing biosecurity changes thanfarms with <5 employees (risk ratio [RR] = 2.26; 95%CI: 1.24–4.10), and farms using robotic milking systemswere more likely to report changes than farms using parloror rotary systems (RR = 2.07; 95% CI: 1.21–3.55).From a mediation analysis (n = 93), the estimated probabilityof implementing biosecurity changes was 45.7%among producers who perceived biosecurity as effective,compared with 21.4% among those who did not, correspondingto a 24.3 percentage-point difference (95% CI:5.4–42.4). On the odds-ratio (OR) scale, perceived biosecurityeffectiveness was associated with greater oddsof implementing biosecurity changes (OR = 3.17; 95%CI: 1.21–8.26), greater concern about HPAI (OR = 4.26;95% CI: 1.58–11.51), and greater odds of perceiving thefarm as lower risk than other farms in the state (OR =2.56; 95% CI: 1.05–6.25). The indirect effect throughconcern about HPAI was 9.4 percentage points, accountingfor ~39% of the total association, whereas the indirecteffect through perceived farm-level risk was smalland not clearly different from zero. Overall, these findingssuggest that implementation of biosecurity changesmay be supported by trusted communication strategiesthat emphasize the effectiveness of specific biosecuritypractices and present the disease as a relevant but stillmanageable farm-level threat, and better align producers’perceptions with evidence-supported transmissionpathways, particularly modifiable routes such as animalmovement, personnel movement, and shared equipment.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores dairy producers' perceptions of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 and their influence on biosecurity changes. It highlights the challenges producers face in making biosecurity decisions with limited information, balancing guidance, beliefs, and farm constraints. The research aimed to describe perceptions, characterize experiences, identify farm characteristics associated with biosecurity changes, and assess the relationship between perceived biosecurity effectiveness and implementation. A questionnaire was sent to Michigan dairy facilities, achieving a 15.6% response rate. Descriptive statistics and regression analyses were used to evaluate responses. Results showed that 15% of respondents reported confirmed or suspected HPAI on their farms. Among unaffected farms, those with more employees and robotic milking systems were more likely to implement biosecurity changes. The study found that perceived biosecurity effectiveness significantly influenced implementation, with a 24.3 percentage-point difference observed. It also noted that concern about HPAI and perceived farm-level risk played a role in this relationship. The findings suggest that effective communication strategies emphasizing biosecurity practices and presenting HPAI as a manageable threat could support better implementation of biosecurity measures. However, the study's reliance on self-reported data introduces potential bias, limiting the confidence in the results. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the study design and statistical methods used.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于高致病性禽流感(HPAI)H5N1在奶牛中的出现所带来的挑战,本研究是必要的,这些挑战要求生产者在有限信息的基础上做出生物安全决策,同时平衡不断变化的指导方针、既有信念和农场管理限制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究旨在描述奶业生产者对HPAI的认知和理解,刻画受影响生产者的经验及其感知影响,识别与应对HPAI风险实施生物安全措施相关的农场特征,并评估感知生物安全措施的有效性是否与实施生物安全措施相关。通过邮寄问卷给密歇根州的奶业设施,获得了15.6%的回复率(n=120/766)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用描述性统计、修改后的泊松回归、逻辑回归和参数g-计算的并行中介分析来评估调查回复和与实施生物安全措施的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 总体而言,18名受访者(15%)报告其农场出现了确认或疑似HPAI。在未报告确认或疑似HPAI的农场中,员工数≥15的农场比员工数<5的农场更可能报告实施了生物安全措施(风险比[RR]=2.26;95%CI:1.24–4.10),而使用机器人挤奶系统的农场比使用挤奶厅或旋转挤奶系统的农场更可能报告实施了措施(RR=2.07;95%CI:1.21–3.55)。从中介分析(n=93)来看,认为生物安全措施有效的生产者实施生物安全措施的概率估计为45.7%,而认为无效的生产者仅为21.4%,相差24.3个百分点(95%CI:5.4–42.4)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,实施生物安全措施可能受到值得信赖的沟通策略的支持,这些策略强调特定生物安全措施的有效性,并将该疾病呈现为相关但仍然可控的农场层面威胁。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为制定针对性的沟通策略提供信息,以提高奶业生产者对生物安全措施的实施,特别是通过将他们的认知与基于证据的传播途径(尤其是可修改的途径,如动物移动、人员流动和共享设备)对齐。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖自我报告数据,以及基于感知的回应可能存在偏差,但鉴于使用了统计分析和相对较大的样本量,证据是强有力的。

Among farms without reported confirmedor suspected HPAI, farms with ≥15 employees were morelikely to report implementing biosecurity changes thanfarms with <5 employees (risk ratio [RR] = 2.26; 95%CI: 1.24–4.10), and farms using robotic milking systemswere more likely to report changes than farms using parloror rotary systems (RR = 2.07; 95% CI: 1.21–3.55).From a mediation analysis (n = 93), the estimated probabilityof implementing biosecurity changes was 45.7%among producers who perceived biosecurity as effective,compared with 21.4% among those who did not, correspondingto a 24.3 percentage-point difference (95% CI:5.4–42.4). On the odds-ratio (OR) scale, perceived biosecurityeffectiveness was associated with greater oddsof implementing biosecurity changes (OR = 3.17; 95%CI: 1.21–8.26), greater concern about HPAI (OR = 4.26;95% CI: 1.58–11.51), and greater odds of perceiving thefarm as lower risk than other farms in the state (OR =2.56; 95% CI: 1.05–6.25). The indirect effect throughconcern about HPAI was 9.4 percentage points, accountingfor ~39% of the total association, whereas the indirecteffect through perceived farm-level risk was smalland not clearly different from zero. Overall, these findingssuggest that implementation of biosecurity changesmay be supported by trusted communication strategiesthat emphasize the effectiveness of specific biosecuritypractices and present the disease as a relevant but stillmanageable farm-level threat, and better align producers’perceptions with evidence-supported transmissionpathways, particularly modifiable routes such as animalmovement, personnel movement, and shared equipment.
abstract_zh: 高致病性禽流感(HPAI)H5N1在奶牛中的出现给美国奶业生产者带来了重大挑战,他们必须在有限的信息基础上做出生物安全决策,同时平衡不断变化的指导方针、既有信念和农场管理限制。本研究旨在:(1)描述奶业生产者对HPAI的认知和理解;(2)刻画受影响生产者的经验及其感知影响;(3)识别与应对HPAI风险实施生物安全措施相关的农场特征;(4)评估感知生物安全措施的有效性是否与实施生物安全措施相关,以及对HPAI的担忧和感知的农场层面风险是否有助于解释这种关系。通过邮寄问卷给密歇根州的奶业设施,获得了15.6%的回复率(n=120/766)。使用描述性统计、修改后的泊松回归、逻辑回归和参数g-计算的并行中介分析来评估调查回复和与实施生物安全措施的关联。总体而言,18名受访者(15%)报告其农场出现了确认或疑似HPAI。大多数受访者表示对HPAI中度到高度熟悉(76%),并认为获得了足够的疾病指导(83%)。最常选择的信息来源是兽医专业人士(72%)、政府卫生机构(52%)和行业协会(48%)。受影响的生产者中最常识别的HPAI引入途径是野生动物(74%),其次是空气传播(34%)、牛群移动(23%)以及与其他农场共享工作人员(12%)。在报告了临床阶段的农场中,中位数持续时间为21天,而生产力下降的中位数持续时间为40天。每头泌乳牛的自我估计经济损失中位数为152美元。在未报告确认或疑似HPAI的农场中,员工数≥15的农场比员工数<5的农场更可能报告实施了生物安全措施(风险比[RR]=2.26;95%CI:1.24–4.10),而使用机器人挤奶系统的农场比使用挤奶厅或旋转挤奶系统的农场更可能报告实施了措施(RR=2.07;95%CI:1.21–3.55)。从中介分析(n=93)来看,认为生物安全措施有效的生产者实施生物安全措施的概率估计为45.7%,而认为无效的生产者仅为21.4%,相差24.3个百分点(95%CI:5.4–42.4)。在比值比(OR)尺度上,感知生物安全措施的有效性与实施生物安全措施的更高可能性相关(OR=3.17;95%CI:1.21–8.26),对HPAI的担忧与实施生物安全措施的更高可能性相关(OR=4.26;95%CI:1.58–11.51),以及认为自己的农场风险低于州内其他农场的可能性更高(OR=2.56;95%CI:1.05–6.25)。通过担忧HPAI的间接效应为9.4个百分点,约占总关联的39%;而通过感知农场层面风险的间接效应较小,且不明显不同于零。总体而言,这些发现表明,实施生物安全措施可能受到值得信赖的沟通策略的支持,这些策略强调特定生物安全措施的有效性,并将该疾病呈现为相关但仍然可控的农场层面威胁。此外,这些发现还表明,更好地将生产者的认知与基于证据的传播途径(特别是可修改的途径,如动物移动、人员流动和共享设备)对齐,可能有助于提高生物安全措施的实施率。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于高致病性禽流感(HPAI)H5N1在奶牛中的出现所带来的挑战,本研究是必要的,这些挑战要求生产者在有限信息的基础上做出生物安全决策,同时平衡不断变化的指导方针、既有信念和农场管理限制。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究旨在描述奶业生产者对HPAI的认知和理解,刻画受影响生产者的经验及其感知影响,识别与应对HPAI风险实施生物安全措施相关的农场特征,并评估感知生物安全措施的有效性是否与实施生物安全措施相关。通过邮寄问卷给密歇根州的奶业设施,获得了15.6%的回复率(n=120/766)。

title: A GIS-based framework for standardized environmental characterization in One-Health surveillance: a case study of highly pathogenic avian influenza monitoring in Italian wetlands
abstract: The Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) panzootic caused by H5 viruses of clade 2.3.4.4b is constantly re-shaping disease ecology in terms of spatio-temporal spread and host spectrum. Because of this, there is an increasing need to complement traditional surveillance methods with approaches that consider environmental factors into epidemiological interpretation. Although environmental surveillance is increasingly recognized within a One Health framework, environmental descriptors are not always consistently structured, underscoring the importance of adopting standardized approaches for their collection and management. A GIS-based framework was developed to standardize environmental characterization of HPAI surveillance sites. Environmental data were collected at nine wetlands in north-eastern Italy, using ESRI field map tool, synchronised through ArcGIS online. Data were validated with field-base ground truthing, stored in a spatial relational database and aggregated into harmonised site-specific descriptors, suitable for epidemiological modelling and analyses. This study introduces a GIS-based framework designed to standardize how environmental features are recorded at sampling sites for HPAI surveillance. The workflow turns different types of field observations into organized geographical datasets that can be analysed. When used at wetland surveillance sites in north-eastern Italy, this framework produced consistent environmental data and standardized records for each site. The workflow combines mobile GIS tools (ESRI Field Maps), ArcGIS Online/Pro, and a PostGIS database to create standardized outputs for epidemiological analysis. This setup creates a reliable connection between field ecology, spatial data infrastructures, and disease risk analysis.

abstract_zh: 由2.3.4.4b亚型H5病毒引起的高致病性禽流感(HPAI)疫情不断重塑疾病生态学的时空传播特征和病原体谱系。因此,有必要将传统方法与考虑环境因素的流行病学解释方法相结合。尽管环境特征在One Health框架中日益受到重视,但环境描述符并不总是结构一致,这凸显了采用标准化方法进行数据收集和管理的重要性。为此,开发了一个基于地理信息系统(GIS)的框架,用于标准化高致病性禽流感(HPAI)疫情发生地的环境特征描述。在意大利东北部的九个湿地中,使用ESRI Field Maps工具收集了环境数据,并通过ArcGIS在线平台进行同步。数据通过实地验证进行校准,存储在空间关系型数据库中,并汇总为适用于流行病学建模和分析的标准化站点描述符。本研究介绍了一种基于GIS的框架,旨在标准化高致病性禽流感(HPAI)疫情发生地采样点的环境特征记录方式。该工作流程将不同类型的现场观察转化为有组织的地理数据集,便于分析。当在意大利东北部湿地中应用该框架时,能够产生一致的环境数据和标准化的站点记录。该工作流程结合了移动GIS工具(ESRI Field Maps)、ArcGIS在线/专业版以及PostGIS数据库,以创建适用于流行病学分析的标准化输出。这种设置建立了现场生态学、空间数据基础设施和疾病风险分析之间的可靠联系。

analysis.scope_and_question: This scoping review protocol aims to explore surveillance approaches for bird-to-human avian influenza transmission in England. The focus is on avian influenza A viruses, avian-origin zoonotic infections, and qualified avian subtypes. The central question is to identify and map the existing literature on surveillance methods for avian influenza transmission to humans.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a scoping review protocol, which outlines the methodology for systematically identifying, selecting, and synthesizing relevant literature. The evidence is sourced from the provided protocol, which describes the research project, aims, and expected outcomes. The review does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates, but it outlines the general approach to literature synthesis.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review protocol does not report on substantive conclusions or pooled estimates. It outlines the research objectives and the framework for conducting the scoping review, but no evidence-supported findings are provided.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The supplied evidence does not report on controversies or evidence gaps. It focuses on the methodology and objectives of the scoping review rather than on conflicting findings or unresolved questions.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review protocol does not provide specific research or practice implications. It outlines the scope and methodology but does not suggest actionable priorities for surveillance, diagnosis, treatment, or policy.

title: Probiotics as a Strategy for Mitigating Viral Infections in Poultry: Immunomodulatory Mechanisms and Therapeutic Potential.
abstract: Poultry viral infections remain a persistent challenge for the poultry industry, causing significant economic losses and posing potential threats to human health. The escalating frequency of outbreaks involving pathogens, such as infectious bronchitis virus (IBV), Newcastle disease virus (NDV) and avian influenza virus (AIV), underscores the urgent need for effective interventions. Probiotics have gained attention as a promising strategy to combat these viral infections due to their potential in enhancing immune responses and establishing a healthy gut microbiome. A literature search was carried out on Google Scholar, Scopus and PubMed using key search terms, such as 'probiotics', 'Lactobacillus', 'acidophilus', 'poultry', 'viral infections', 'Newcastle Disease Virus (NDV)' and other relevant terms. Inclusion criteria for manuscripts used were based on the relevance to probiotic-based interventions in poultry, the focus on immunological mechanisms and the examination of viral pathogens commonly found in West African poultry farming systems. This review explores the role of probiotics in mitigating the effects of NDV, AIV and IBV in poultry, focusing on their immunomodulatory effects and antiviral mechanisms. Lactobacillus acidophilus, L. plantarum have shown an interesting promise in countering NDV infections by modulating immunological parameters and enhancing antibody responses. Similarly, these probiotics have exhibited antiviral activity against AIV, promoting immune activation and reducing viral loads. plantarum have emerged as potential adjuvants for IBV vaccines, improving antibody responses and humoural immunity.

title_zh: 益生菌作为缓解禽类病毒感染的策略:免疫调节机制与治疗潜力
source_body_en: Poultry viral infections remain a persistent challenge for the poultry industry, causing significant economic losses and posing potential threats to human health. The escalating frequency of outbreaks involving pathogens, such as infectious bronchitis virus (IBV), Newcastle disease virus (NDV) and avian influenza virus (AIV), underscores the urgent need for effective interventions. Probiotics have gained attention as a promising strategy to combat these viral infections due to their potential in enhancing immune responses and establishing a healthy gut microbiome. A literature search was carried out on Google Scholar, Scopus and PubMed using key search terms, such as 'probiotics', 'Lactobacillus', 'acidophilus', 'poultry', 'viral infections', 'Newcastle Disease Virus (NDV)' and other relevant terms. Inclusion criteria for manuscripts used were based on the relevance to probiotic-based interventions in poultry, the focus on immunological mechanisms and the examination of viral pathogens commonly found in West African poultry farming systems. This review explores the role of probiotics in mitigating the effects of NDV, AIV and IBV in poultry, focusing on their immunomodulatory effects and antiviral mechanisms. Lactobacillus acidophilus, L. plantarum have shown an interesting promise in countering NDV infections by modulating immunological parameters and enhancing antibody responses. Similarly, these probiotics have exhibited antiviral activity against AIV, promoting immune activation and reducing viral loads. plantarum have emerged as potential adjuvants for IBV vaccines, improving antibody responses and humoural immunity.
abstract_zh: 禽类病毒感染仍然是禽类养殖业中的持续挑战,导致显著的经济损失并可能对人类健康构成潜在威胁。涉及病原体的病毒感染频率不断上升,例如传染性支气管炎病毒(IBV)、新城疫病毒(NDV)和禽流感病毒(AIV),凸显了对有效干预措施的迫切需求。由于益生菌在增强免疫应答和建立健康肠道微生物群方面具有潜力,它们已成为一种有前景的策略,用于对抗这些病毒感染。通过在Google Scholar、Scopus和PubMed上使用关键搜索词,如'益生菌'、'乳酸杆菌'、'嗜酸乳杆菌'、'禽类'、'病毒感染'、'新城疫病毒(NDV)'及其他相关术语进行了文献检索。所选文献的纳入标准基于其与禽类益生菌干预措施的相关性、对免疫机制的关注以及对西非禽类养殖系统中常见病毒病原体的分析。本综述探讨了益生菌在减轻NDV、AIV和IBV对禽类影响中的作用,重点在于其免疫调节效应和抗病毒机制。嗜酸乳杆菌(Lactobacillus acidophilus)和植物乳杆菌(L. plantarum)在调节免疫参数和增强抗体反应方面显示出对抗NDV感染的有趣前景。同样,这些益生菌在对抗AIV方面也表现出抗病毒活性,促进免疫激活并降低病毒载量。植物乳杆菌在应对IBV病毒感染方面已显示出潜在的辅助作用,改善抗体反应和体液免疫。

title: Spatiotemporal genomic epidemiology of Eurasian avian-like H1N1 swine influenza viruses
abstract: Abstract Background Eurasian avian-like (EA) H1N1 swine influenza viruses pose a zoonotic threat, yet their genomic evolution and dissemination across Eurasia remain incompletely understood. This study investigated genotype diversity, temporal persistence, and geographic spread, and assessed the association between live-swine trade and viral migration to inform surveillance. Methods We analysed 1,703 publicly available EA H1N1 genomes sampled from 19 countries between 2009 and 2025. Lineage assignments across all eight gene segments were used to identify genotypes and describe their temporal and geographic distributions. Time-scaled Bayesian phylogenetics and discrete phylogeography were used to reconstruct evolutionary relationships and migration patterns. Generalized linear modelling assessed migration predictors, including directed live-swine trade and sampling intensity. The mixed effects model of evolution was used to detect episodic diversifying selection in hemagglutinin, followed by structural mapping of candidate residues. Results We identified 19 genotypes. The wholly EA-derived genotype G1 accounted for 57.0% of genomes and was detected across nearly the entire study period. Many reassortant genotypes carrying A(H1N1)pdm09- or triple-reassortant-derived segments were detected over short intervals, although several showed prolonged persistence. Genotype composition differed geographically, with reassortant genotypes enriched in Asia and predominantly EA-derived constellations more common in Europe. Phylogeographic reconstruction indicated asymmetric dissemination within and between Europe and Asia, with Western Europe occupying a central position in the inferred migration network. Directed live-swine trade received the strongest support among migration predictors after accounting for sampling intensity. Sixteen candidate hemagglutinin codons showed evidence of episodic diversifying selection. Most candidate HA1 residues mapped to exposed regions of the globular head near antigenic regions. Conclusions EA H1N1 evolution across Eurasia was characterized by a persistent EA genomic background, regional genotype diversification through reassortment, and spread associated with live-swine trade. These findings support integrating genomic surveillance with animal movement data to guide surveillance along trade networks and improve the detection and assessment of emerging variants of zoonotic concern.

title: AEX-1: A Vero cell variant with enhanced permissiveness for influenza virus replication.
abstract: Background Continuous cell substrates with improved permissiveness for influenza virus replication are of considerable interest for vaccine development and manufacturing. Vero cells have an excellent regulatory track record; however, their relatively low influenza virus productivity limits their broader application. Methods We developed the AEX-1 cell line by co-cultivating Vero cells with chicken embryo amniotic membrane fragments. Cellular morphology, intracellular acidification, influenza virus replication, transcriptomic profile, genetic stability, and tumorigenicity were evaluated. Results AEX-1 cells displayed distinct morphology and enhanced endosomal/lysosomal acidification compared with parental Vero cells. At 72 h post-infection, a commonly used harvest time for influenza vaccine virus production, AEX-1 cells produced higher infectious titres of WHO-recommended egg-derived A/Sydney/5/2021 (H1N1)pdm09-like and B/Austria/1359417/2021 vaccine viruses, with titres approaching those obtained in embryonated chicken eggs and exceeding Vero cell yields by 0.9-1.7 log 10 EID 50 /ml. No replication advantage was observed for the egg-derived A/Croatia/10136RV/2023 (H3N2) vaccine virus, carrying the egg-adaptive HA G53D substitution, or for the egg-derived A/duck/Vietnam/NCVD-1584/2012 (H5N1) vaccine strain. However, the A/Darwin/9/2021-like Vero-derived primary isolate A/Austria/1516645/2022 (H3N2), lacking G53D, reached infectious titres up to 3.0 log 10 TCID 50 /ml higher than in Vero and 2.3 log 10 TCID 50 /ml higher than in MDCK cells. H1N1 UniFluVec-based influenza virus vectors also replicated efficiently in AEX-1 cells. Transcriptomic analysis revealed changes in genes involved in proton transport, vesicular acidification, and intracellular pH regulation. AEX-1 remained genetically stable after prolonged passaging and showed no evidence of increased tumorigenicity in vitro or in vivo. Conclusions Enhanced intracellular acidification may contribute to improved influenza virus replication in AEX-1 cells, suggesting that modulation of endosomal acidification may provide a rational strategy for developing improved cell substrates for influenza vaccine production.

title: Developing and benchmarking one health genomic surveillance tools for influenza A virus in wastewater
abstract: Abstract Influenza A viruses (IAV) remain a persistent One Health threat, and whole-genome sequencing from wastewater offers a promising surveillance tool. However, IAV is at low abundance in wastewater, making it difficult to sequence. We benchmark four targeted enrichment methods suited for multi-subtype whole-genome IAV sequencing including custom and off-the-shelf methods. Our custom HA tiled-amplicon panel is sensitive, fast, and cost-effective, making it suitable for monitoring low-abundance seasonal variants of known subtypes, although its reliance on conserved and intact primer-binding sites limits primer design to fewer subtypes. A published universal amplicon method targets all IAV subtypes but performs poorly in wastewater due to its reliance on intact genome segments. Meanwhile, probe-capture methods are resilient to RNA degradation. In real wastewater samples, our custom probe panel recovers whole-genome signals from circulating H1N1, H3N2, H5N1, including validated H5N1 2.3.4.4b reads in samples where dPCR detection is limited. However, probe-capture is generally more costly and labor-intensive than amplicon methods. Across all four sequencing methods, two wastewater matrices, and most spike-in and endogenous virus targets, ultrafiltration-based virus concentration consistently outperforms large-volume direct extraction. Together, these benchmarking comparisons and custom panels provide needed information for implementing IAV genomic sequencing in routine wastewater surveillance.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the effectiveness of four targeted enrichment methods for whole-genome sequencing of influenza A viruses (IAV) in wastewater. The research highlights the challenges of IAV detection in low-abundance environments and introduces a custom HA tiled-amplicon panel as a sensitive, fast, and cost-effective tool for monitoring seasonal variants. The study demonstrates that ultrafiltration-based virus concentration outperforms other methods in wastewater samples. The custom panel is suitable for known subtypes but has limitations due to reliance on conserved primer-binding sites. The findings suggest that these methods can improve genomic surveillance of avian influenza in wastewater, though the evidence is based on abstract-only data. The study contributes to the development of tools for IAV monitoring, emphasizing the importance of tailored approaches for low-abundance variants.

title_zh: 开发和基准测试用于废水中的甲型流感病毒的One Health 基因组监测工具
source_body_en: Abstract Influenza A viruses (IAV) remain a persistent One Health threat, and whole-genome sequencing from wastewater offers a promising surveillance tool. However, IAV is at low abundance in wastewater, making it difficult to sequence. We benchmark four targeted enrichment methods suited for multi-subtype whole-genome IAV sequencing including custom and off-the-shelf methods. Our custom HA tiled-amplicon panel is sensitive, fast, and cost-effective, making it suitable for monitoring low-abundance seasonal variants of known subtypes, although its reliance on conserved and intact primer-binding sites limits primer design to fewer subtypes. A published universal amplicon method targets all IAV subtypes but performs poorly in wastewater due to its reliance on intact genome segments. Meanwhile, probe-capture methods are resilient to RNA degradation. In real wastewater samples, our custom probe panel recovers whole-genome signals from circulating H1N1, H3N2, H5N1, including validated H5N1 2.3.4.4b reads in samples where dPCR detection is limited. However, probe-capture is generally more costly and labor-intensive than amplicon methods. Across all four sequencing methods, two wastewater matrices, and most spike-in and endogenous virus targets, ultrafiltration-based virus concentration consistently outperforms large-volume direct extraction. Together, these benchmarking comparisons and custom panels provide needed information for implementing IAV genomic sequencing in routine wastewater surveillance.
abstract_zh: 摘要 甲型流感病毒(IAV)仍然是一个持续的One Health威胁,从废水中进行全基因组测序提供了一种有前景的监测工具。然而,IAV在废水中的丰度较低,使得测序变得困难。我们对四种适用于多亚型全基因组 IAV测序的靶向富集方法进行了基准测试,包括定制和现成的方法。我们的定制HA tiled-amplicon面板具有灵敏、快速和成本效益的特点,使其适用于监测已知亚型低丰度的季节性变种,尽管其依赖于保守且完整的引物结合位点,这限制了引物设计的亚型数量。一种已发表的通用amplicon方法可针对所有IAV亚型,但由于依赖于完整的基因组片段,在废水样本中表现不佳。同时,探针捕获方法对RNA降解具有较强的抵抗力。在实际废水样本中,我们的定制探针面板能够从循环中的H1N1、H3N2、H5N1中回收全基因组信号,包括在dPCR检测受限的样本中验证的H5N1 2.3.4.4b读数。然而,探针捕获方法通常比amplicon方法更昂贵且劳动密集。在所有四种测序方法、两种废水基质以及大多数spike-in和内源性病毒目标中,基于超滤的病毒浓缩方法始终优于大体积直接提取。综上所述,这些基准测试比较和定制面板为在常规废水监测中实施IAV基因组测序提供了必要的信息。

full_text: The cow udder as an influenza mixing ground Bovine mammary tissue can support infection and replication of diverse influenza A viruses and may provide an environment in which different viral strains can co-infect cells. Related research article Pinto RM, Sharp CP, Beeson M, Pankaew N, Hassard JA, Moxom A, Magill C, Ross RA, Tuck L, Meek S, Lee HM, Jensen K, Dry I, Melo P, Yang J, Tan WS, Raut AA, Mishra A, de Wit S, Fitzgerald JR, Hope JC, Joanne Stevens S, Tom Burdon T, Sutton K, Esteves CL, Donadeu FX, Brown I, Barclay W, Peacock TP, Goldhill DH, Iqbal M, Murcia PR, Haslam SM, Gaunt E, Digard P. 2026. The cow udder is a potential coinfection site for influenza A viruses. eLife 15:RP111076. doi: 10.7554/eLife.111076. Avian flu is caused by the influenza A virus and mostly affects birds. But depending on its subtype, the virus can infect a wide range of host species, including mammals. Pigs are considered potential “gene mixing vessels” for multiple viral subtypes, as they can be infected with avian, swine, and human influenza A viruses. Since 2020, the subtype H5N1 (clade 2.3.4.4b) has spread globally, causing mass mortalities in wild birds and poultry, and frequent transmission to several mammalian species, including occasional human infections. In spring 2024, H5N1 was detected in dairy cattle in the United States, where the virus subsequently spread among herds across several states. This sustained circulation has raised questions about whether cattle may also provide opportunities for further viral adaptation and reassortment. To date, two genotypes have been identified in US dairy cattle: B3.13, which was the first to infect dairy cows, and D1.1, which crossed the species barrier more recently in early 2025. Intriguingly, cows do not show respiratory symptoms. Instead, they develop an abrupt drop in milk production, which correlates with high levels of virus in the milk. Human infections with ‘cow flu’ have also been reported, and laboratory studies have shown that bovine-derived isolates can replicate and cause disease in different animal models. However, human-to-human transmission has not yet been reported. Now, in eLife, Rute Maria Pinto, Colin P. Sharp, Eleanor Gaunt, Paul Digard and colleagues report new insights on how the cow udder could serve as a mixing vessel for different strains of influenza A viruses. The researchers, based at various research institutes in the United Kingdom, India and the Netherlands, infected different cow-derived cells with bovine, as well as avian, human and swine virus strains, and analyzed the virus’ ability to replicate and infect various bovine cells (Figure 1). The results showed that mammary cells could easily be infected by many different influenza A viruses. They then compared the fitness of bovine viruses with that of an avian precursor strain. Using several assays to measure viral replication, they found that three of the eight RNA gene segments of an influenza A virus (PB2, PA, and NS) improved the B3.13 virus’s ability to adapt to bovine cells. Properties of different bovine mammary gland culture models. Different approaches have been used to model the bovine mammary gland. These include two cell line models: a continuous cell line (MAC-T), which can be grown and divided repeatedly, and a primary bovine mammary cell line (bMEC) isolated from tissue. Infection of both cell lines supports efficient replication of influenza A viruses across different subtypes and serotypes. Mass spectrometry analysis revealed a complex glycome in both cell lines (top of the figure). When a tissue explant was infected with 2.3.4.4b viruses, viral replication efficiency differed between strains (bottom of the figure). The explant glycome has yet to be characterized. Furthermore, Pinto et al. used reassortant or ‘mixed’ viruses containing two gene segments from one virus and six from another, carrying PR8 glycoproteins HA and NA as their surface proteins (2:6) – molecules that help the virus attach, enter, and leave host cells. This approach revealed that unadapted 2:6 2.3.4.4b strains, including avian Eurasian strains, could also replicate to high levels in cow mammary cells. These findings are consistent with other studies reporting the susceptibility of various bovine cell culture systems to different influenza viruses, including replication in bovine skin fibroblasts and mammary gland organoids (e.g.,). Working with H5N1-infected, lactating cattle in high containment presents obvious infrastructural and logistical challenges. Thus, developing alternative bovine models that maintain biological relevance while reducing operational complexity is warranted. However, many models may lose some bovine characteristics in culture. When Pinto et al. infected mammary explants – the closest culture system to the actual udder – they found marked differences in viral quantities between bovine and precursor H5N1 strains. Thus, a bovine-adapted phenotype is relevant for achieving high viral loads in the cow udder. Noticeably, the viruses used in the infection experiments were 2:6 viruses again. The circulating bovine viruses have unique receptor-binding properties and are more promiscuous than classical H5 viruses before the introduction of the 2.3.4.4 antigenic clade. It is, thus, unclear whether the different authentic H5N1 viruses would similarly infect these relevant cultures. To further investigate the cow udder’s potential as a mixing vessel, the presence of both avian-type and human-type sialic acid receptors, which can serve as attachment points for influenza viruses, was examined using mass spectrometry. They found both receptor types, concluding that their infection experiments provide evidence that bovine cells can support infection with many different influenza A viruses. However, it would be useful to analyze the complete collection of sugars present on the cells and tissues of the explants and determine whether differences exist between cow tissues. Importantly, current mass spectrometry analyses have a clear caveat: they only represent possible glycan structures inferred from their measured masses rather than definitive structural assignments. Finally, a co-infection experiment in bovine cells using a human and an avian influenza strain produced a cell population infected with both viruses, providing an important proof of principle for co-infection and reassortment. Taken together, the study by Pinto et al. supports the hypothesis that co-infections of human and avian viruses within the cow mammary glands are possible and thus reassortment events in the cow udder cannot be ruled out. title_original: The cow udder as an influenza mixing ground

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate whether the cow udder could serve as a mixing ground for influenza A viruses, particularly in light of the global spread of H5N1 and its ability to infect mammals. This is important because the sustained circulation of H5N1 in dairy cattle raises concerns about its potential for further adaptation and reassortment.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted using bovine-derived cell lines and tissue explants, with a focus on H5N1-infected dairy cattle in the United States. The researchers infected different cow-derived cells with various influenza A virus strains, including avian, human, and swine viruses, to analyze their replication and infection capabilities.
analysis.methods: The researchers used several assays to measure viral replication and compared the fitness of bovine viruses with an avian precursor strain. They also performed co-infection experiments in bovine cells using human and avian influenza strains to assess the potential for co-infection and reassortment.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that mammary cells could be infected by many different influenza A viruses. Additionally, co-infection experiments in bovine cells using human and avian influenza strains produced a cell population infected with both viruses, providing proof of principle for co-infection and reassortment.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings support the hypothesis that co-infections of human and avian viruses within the cow mammary glands are possible, thus reassortment events in the cow udder cannot be ruled out.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study highlights the potential role of the cow udder in facilitating viral adaptation and reassortment, which has implications for surveillance and understanding the evolution of influenza A viruses, particularly H5N1, in mammalian hosts.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study has limitations, including the use of cell lines that may lose some bovine characteristics in culture, and the current mass spectrometry analyses only infer possible glycan structures rather than definitively assigning them. Despite these limitations, the evidence is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates whether the cow udder can serve as a mixing ground for influenza A viruses, particularly H5N1, which has been detected in dairy cattle in the United States. The researchers infected bovine-derived cells with various influenza strains, including avian, human, and swine viruses, and found that mammary cells could be easily infected by many different influenza A viruses. Co-infection experiments demonstrated the potential for co-infection and reassortment, supporting the hypothesis that the cow udder may facilitate viral adaptation. The study highlights the importance of understanding this potential role for surveillance and public health, but it has limitations, such as the use of cell lines that may not fully represent bovine tissue characteristics and the reliance on inferred glycan structures from mass spectrometry. The evidence is moderate, as the findings are based on laboratory experiments rather than direct field observations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨奶牛乳房是否可以作为甲型流感病毒的混合场所,特别是在H5N1全球传播及其能够感染哺乳动物的背景下。这一点很重要,因为H5N1在奶牛中的持续传播引发了其进一步适应和重组的担忧。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用了源自牛的细胞系和组织切片,重点关注美国H5N1感染奶牛的情况。研究人员将不同来源的牛细胞感染多种甲型流感病毒株,包括禽类、人类和猪类病毒,以分析其复制和感染能力。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用了多种实验来测量病毒复制,并比较了牛病毒与禽类前体株的适应性。他们还使用人类和 禽流感 株在牛细胞中进行了共感染实验,以评估共感染和重组的潜力。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究结果表明,乳腺细胞可以被多种不同的甲型流感病毒感染。此外,在牛细胞中使用人类和 禽流感 株进行共感染实验产生了同时感染两种病毒的细胞群体,为共感染和重组提供了原理性证据。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现支持了人类和禽类病毒在牛乳腺中共感染的可能性,因此不能排除牛乳房中发生重组事件的可能。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究突显了奶牛乳房在促进病毒适应和重组中的潜在作用,这对 监测 和理解甲型流感病毒,特别是H5N1,在哺乳动物 宿主 中的 进化 具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究存在局限性,包括使用可能在培养过程中失去部分牛特性的细胞系,以及当前的质谱分析只能推断可能的糖基结构,而不能明确确定它们。尽管存在这些局限性,但证据是中等的。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨奶牛乳房是否可以作为甲型流感病毒的混合场所,特别是在H5N1全球传播及其能够感染哺乳动物的背景下。这一点很重要,因为H5N1在奶牛中的持续传播引发了其进一步适应和重组的担忧。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用了源自牛的细胞系和组织切片,重点关注美国H5N1感染奶牛的情况。研究人员将不同来源的牛细胞感染多种甲型流感病毒株,包括禽类、人类和猪类病毒,以分析其复制和感染能力。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员使用了多种实验来测量病毒复制,并比较了牛病毒与禽类前体株的适应性。他们还使用人类和 禽流感 株在牛细胞中进行了共感染实验,以评估共感染和重组的潜力。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究结果表明,乳腺细胞可以被多种不同的甲型流感病毒感染。此外,在牛细胞中使用人类和 禽流感 株进行共感染实验产生了同时感染两种病毒的细胞群体,为共感染和重组提供了原理性证据。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现支持了人类和禽类病毒在牛乳腺中共感染的可能性,因此不能排除牛乳房中发生重组事件的可能。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究突显了奶牛乳房在促进病毒适应和重组中的潜在作用,这对 监测 和理解甲型流感病毒,特别是H5N1,在哺乳动物 宿主 中的 进化 具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究存在局限性,包括使用可能在培养过程中失去部分牛特性的细胞系,以及当前的质谱分析只能推断可能的糖基结构,而不能明确确定它们。尽管存在这些局限性,但证据是中等的。
